source.section: Form M1 lines 1-4, 7-10 (instructions PDF p.13 Standard Deduction Table for Line 4, p.14 Worksheet A, p.39 Tax Rate Schedules, pp.32-38 tax table); Schedule M1R lines 1-13 and Line 10 table (M1R PDF p.1, p.2); Form M1 instructions PDF p.15; M1M PDF p.5 line 16

worked: AGI 33,699, one dollar under the printed 33,700 limit: 0.50 is left. The form rounds to whole dollars; expected does not. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution 33,699.00 = 33,699.00. Federal taxable income = 33,699.00 - 17,750.00 federal standard deduction (15,750 plus 1 x 2,000) = 15,949.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form M1, single: line 1 federal AGI 33,699.00. Schedule M1M line 1 other-state municipal interest 0.00; line 10 additions 0.00; Form M1 line 2 0.00; line 3 = 33,699.00. Schedule M1R: line 1 9,600.00; line 2 0.00 (65 or older); line 3 9,600.00; line 4 0.00; line 5 nontaxable Social Security 0.00 - 0.00 = 0.00; line 6 Railroad Retirement Board benefits 0.00; line 7 0.00; line 8 = 9,600.00. Line 9 33,699.00; line 10 14,500.00; line 11 19,199.00; line 12 9,599.50; line 13 = 0.50. Schedule M1M line 40 = Form M1 line 7 subtractions = 0.00 + 0.50 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.50 (lines 12, 16, 17, 25). State income before deduction = 33,699.00 - 0.50 = 33,698.50. Standard Deduction Table for Line 4 (PDF p.13): base 14,950.00 plus 1 x 2,000 age box(es) = 16,950.00; AGI is not over 238,950.00, so no Worksheet A. Line 4 = 16,950.00. Form M1 line 8 total = 16,950.00 + 0.50 = 16,950.50; line 9 Minnesota taxable income = 33,699.00 - 16,950.50 = 16,748.50. Line 10 tax from the rate schedule (PDF p.39): 5.35% x (16,748.50 - 0.00) = 896.04475 = 896.04475. The tax table (PDF pp.32-38) gives 896; expected keeps the schedule formula. Line 16 credits 0.00; state income tax 896.04.
accepted_approximations: Tax comes from the rate schedules at every income; below 86,800 of taxable income the booklet requires its 100-wide tax table.
